The Project Based Vouchers (PBV) Program is designed to provideassistance to individuals and families residing in designated apartment buildings that meet specific criteria. This program ties a voucher to a particular unit within a specific property. It is important to note that if you currently livein a unit with a PBV and decide to move, the Section 8 assistance associated with the voucher may remain with the property. However, the voucher itself does not automatically transferwith you.The Housing Authority currently administers the PBV program throughout the City of Long Beach for specific buildings, each with its own set of admission criteria.
